packageRules.description: Auto-merge grouped non-major build-input updates (mkdocs plugins in requirements.txt, the python base image, and GitHub Actions) as one PR. The image is tagged from the pinned mkdocs-material version, so merging republishes the current tag (or mints a new one when mkdocs-material itself bumps); adarigod's Renovate then follows it via a reviewed PR. Base-image and plugin MAJORS stay manual, and an image only publishes on a successful build.
Major bumps (e.g. mkdocs-material 9.x -> 10.x, python base image) get their own PR for review.

Auto-merge ALL GitHub Actions bumps including majors. CI-only, low-risk, and the main source of PR churn on this build repo — keep them fully hands-off. A break is caught by the publish build. (Rule is last so it overrides the major-review rule for action majors.)
